newsitem.title: USA: Clinton issues order tightening gun sales.
newsitem.headline: Clinton issues order tightening gun sales.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Wednesday signed a directive requiring people who want to buy a gun to prove that they have resided in a state for at least 90 days to be eligible to possess the weapon.
The measure stems from last month's shooting at the Empire State Building in New York in which one person was killed and six wounded.
The gunman, Ali Abu Kamal, killed himself. He bought the semiautomatic handgun he used in Florida after staying in a motel there for three weeks.
Clinton also ordered all federal law enforcement agencies to require their personnel to place child safety locks on their weapons.
He renewed his request for legislation banning so-called "cop-killer", or armour-piercing, bullets.
